subject: Re: VM evidence — sprint retro & proofchain manifest
messages:
From: Elliot Harper <elliot.harper@finsight.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: audit-team@finsight.com
Date: 2026-11-04T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: VM evidence request: scan cadence + remediation proof

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for taking this on. For our SOC2 readiness review we need a compact evidence packet showing your vulnerability management rhythm and proof of remediation for recent CVEs. Specifically we need:

- Scan cadence for the last 90 days (scheduling and any missed runs)
- SLA commitments for Critical / High / Medium CVEs and how you measure closure
- Proof that CVE-2026-1457 (critical), CVE-2026-1983 (high) and CVE-2026-2074 (high) were triaged and closed (ticket links or patch commits + timestamps)
- A single "proofchain" manifest mapping scans -> findings -> remediation artifacts (patch commits, PRs, rollbacks) that an auditor can follow

Could we get this by end-of-day Nov 6? If that timeline is tight, tell us what you can deliver and when. A zipped packet or a Drive folder link is fine.

Appreciate it — Elliot
Elliot Harper
Senior Auditor, FinSight Capital
elliot.harper@finsight.com
+1 415-555-0198
From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Elliot Harper <elliot.harper@finsight.com>

Hi Elliot — thanks for the clear ask. I'm pulling the artifacts together and will deliver a compact packet to the Drive link below by EOD Nov 6. Quick clarifying questions so we package exactly what you need:

1) Do you need per-host patch windows (we can include per-cluster windows) or is per-environment enough?
2) For the proofchain, would you prefer: (A) single CSV mapping with artifact links, or (B) per-CVE PDF narrative + hyperlinks?

Planned deliverables in the packet:
- vm-scan-summary-90d.csv (scan timestamps, scope, pass/fail)
- patch-commitment-table.pdf (SLA matrix + responsible owners)
- proofchain-manifest.txt (compact mapping file)

I'm looping in Kimberly (security ops) and Tessa (vuln program lead) to confirm the timeline and sign-off.

Thanks,
Marissa Cole
Security Programs Manager
Redwood Inference

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood.com>

On Wed, Nov 4, 2026 at 10:08 AM Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com> wrote:
> Hi Elliot — thanks for the clear ask. I'm pulling the artifacts together and will deliver a compact packet to the Drive link below by EOD Nov 6. Quick clarifying questions so we package exactly what you need:

Hi all — adding the operational specifics to help the auditor follow the chain: 

- Scan cadence: Weekly full authenticated scans of prod fleet (Sundays 02:00 UTC); daily lightweight unauthenticated probes for surface drift (00:30 UTC). No missed runs in the last 90 days; scheduled maintenance windows are flagged in the CSV.
- SLAs: Critical = 7 days to mitigated/rollback or compensating control; High = 30 days to remediation or mitigated plan; Medium = 90 days. We maintain a ticket per finding and annotate remediation status (in progress / verified / deferred).
- CVE proof: CVE-2026-1457 -> ticket RED-4123 (patch merged 2026-09-11, deploy artifact sha: a1b2c3); CVE-2026-1983 -> ticket RED-4210 (workaround + vendor patch applied 2026-10-02); CVE-2026-2074 -> ticket RED-4249 (backport PR + verified 2026-10-28). Links to those tickets are in the proofchain-manifest.txt.

Attachments I'll add to the Drive packet: vm-scan-summary-90d.csv, patch-commitment-table.pdf, proofchain-manifest.txt. Marissa — we can include per-cluster patch windows; per-host is not necessary for this review unless they ask for it. For the proofchain format, I recommend the single CSV mapping (option A) + a short PDF appendix with narrative for the three CVEs.

—Kimberly
Kimberly Park
Security Ops Lead
Redwood Inference

Elliot / audit team — delivering the packet now. Drive folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3c-vm-evidence

Files included (final):
- vm-scan-summary-90d.csv (columns: scan_id, scan_type, target_set, start_ts, end_ts, missed_flag)
- patch-commitment-table.pdf (SLA matrix + owner roster + contact emails)
- proofchain-manifest.txt (rows: cve_id, finding_id, scan_id, ticket_id, commit_sha, link_to_artifact)
- appendix-cve-narratives.pdf (short narrative for CVE-2026-1457, CVE-2026-1983, CVE-2026-2074)

Attestation: On behalf of Redwood Inference I certify that the artifacts above are a true and complete representation of the vulnerability findings and remediation activities for the scope described. Where mitigation was applied instead of immediate patching, compensating controls and timelines are documented in the appendix and the patch-commitment-table.pdf.

Signed,
